game.name: Frantic Dimension
game.desc: This game was highly inspired by The world's first twin stick shooter, Space Dungeon. You are a treasure hunter Jason Allen, who had been teleported to the alternative dimension where aliens called 'Yadcians' are living. The aliens are chasing you to eliminate the intruder, now you have to collect alien treasures and escape The yadcian fortress with the stolen powerful prototype weapon 'Million'.
